participation.context: Answered, and kept the old play unchosen.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Commanded the three nights from Somerset House, and refused the king.
participation.name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon

relations.note: three nights, and not the king
relations.quote: I'll not carry a play to court where a king is talked out of his chair.

story.body: You answered from the tiring-house. You offered Navarre and the lovers. You heard the king refused, and you heard that yesterday's cloak was his. You did not name the old play, and you did not name the heel.

relations.note: three nights, and not the king
relations.quote: I'll not carry a play to court where a king is talked out of his chair.

participation.context: Named yesterday's justice, and refused to choose the old play.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set three nights down as promised, with nothing received.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Heard the ban on the king, and did not guess the heel.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

story.body: You came off the call and named Hunsdon. Heminges kept the promised nights apart from money in hand. You left the old play unnamed.

title: Told Heminges yesterday's country justice was Lord Hunsdon
